claims.claim_text: Viasat completed the acquisition of Inmarsat (Connect Topco Limited) on May 30, 2023 for ~$550.7M cash + 46.36M shares; the Inmarsat acquisition anchors Viasat's communication services segment and roll-up thesis.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.source_quote: On May 30, 2023, we completed the acquisition of Connect Topco Limited... in exchange for approximately $550.7 million in cash and 46.36 million shares of our common stock (the Inmarsat Acquisition).

kwargs.parent_thesis: Viasat is a global satellite communications and government SATCOM/defense technology company integrating its broadband fleet with Inmarsat's L-band global mobility network to serve aviation, maritime, government and consumer customers.

acquisitions.name: Inmarsat (Connect Topco Limited)
acquisitions.description: Global L-band mobile satellite operator providing aviation/maritime/government communications

acquisitions.name: TrellisWare Technologies (majority-owned, ~60%)
acquisitions.description: Tactical mobile ad-hoc networking and waveform subsidiary

claims.claim_text: U.S. Government revenue was ~18% of total FY2025 revenue (~$813M of $4.52B), split roughly equally between communication services and defense and advanced technologies segments.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.source_quote: Revenues from the U.S. Government as an individual customer comprised approximately 18 %, 17 % and 17 % of total revenues for fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

claims.claim_text: Remaining performance obligations were $3.6 billion as of March 31, 2025, with approximately half expected to be recognized over the next 12 months.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.source_quote: As of March 31, 2025, the aggregate amount of the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was $ 3.6 billion, of which the Company expects to recognize approximately half over the next 12 months

claims.claim_text: Viasat sold its Link-16 Tactical Data Links business to L3Harris Technologies on January 3, 2023 for approximately $1.96 billion cash.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.source_quote: On January 3, 2023, we completed the sale of certain assets and assigned liabilities comprising our Link-16 Tactical Data Links business (the Link-16 TDL Business) to L3Harris Technologies, Inc. (L3Harris) in exchange for approximately $1.96 billion in cash

claims.claim_text: Viasat carries $7.2B aggregate principal of indebtedness as of March 31, 2025 (including Inmarsat 9.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2029 at $1.975B) and has shelf registration statements on file enabling unlimited future equity/debt issuance.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.object_value: $7.2B total debt; universal shelf S-3 active
claims.source_quote: As of March 31, 2025, the aggregate principal amount of our total outstanding indebtedness was $7.2 billion... From time to time, we file universal shelf registration statements with the SEC for the future sale of an unlimited amount of common stock, preferred stock, debt securities

claims.claim_text: Viasat is a patent-protected proprietary technology company relying on its IP portfolio in satellite communications, encryption, cybersecurity, modems and waveforms.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.source_quote: Our success depends on our ability to protect our proprietary rights to the technologies we use in our products and services. We generally rely on a combination of patents, copyrights, trademarks and trade secret laws

claims.claim_text: Viasat operates worldwide headquarters at 6155 El Camino Real, Carlsbad, California 92009 with global multi-site operations.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.source_quote: The mailing address of our worldwide headquarters is 6155 El Camino Real, Carlsbad, California 92009

claims.claim_text: Viasat's defense and advanced technologies segment revenue grew to $1.221B in FY2025 (incl. $325M information security/cyber defense products, $305M space/mission systems, $320M tactical networking products) — these are predominantly government-funded programs.
claims.subject: Viasat Defense and Advanced Technologies segment
claims.source_quote: Total defense and advanced technologies revenues 1,221,086... Information security and cyber defense products 325,439... Space and mission systems products 304,870... Tactical networking products 319,577

claims.claim_text: Viasat is subject to DCMA/DCAA audits with $14.8M reserved for potential refunds on multi-year U.S. Government cost-reimbursable contracts; DCMA had only approved incurred costs through FY2022.
claims.subject: Viasat, Inc.
claims.object_value: DCAA fiscal 2024 audit ongoing; $14.8M contract refund reserve
claims.source_quote: As of March 31, 2025, the DCMA had approved the Company's incurred costs through fiscal year 2022. The DCAA is currently auditing the Company's fiscal year 2024 recurring incurred cost submissions... the Company had $ 14.8 million... in contract-related reserves for its estimate of potential refunds

claims.claim_text: Viasat operates internationally with $1.7B net book value of long-lived assets outside the US (incl. $1.2B in the UK from the Inmarsat acquisition) — sponsoring substantial UK facility operations.
claims.subject: Viasat / Inmarsat UK
claims.source_quote: The net book value of long-lived assets located outside the United States was approximately $ 1.7 billion at March 31, 2025... including a net book value of long-lived assets located in the United Kingdom of $ 1.2 billion
